subject: Landing plan & ownership for MediGroup evaluation
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medigroup.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Landing plan & ownership for MediGroup evaluation

Hi Liam — great speaking yesterday. I'm sending a short landing plan to align on owners, goals, and a suggested timeline for the evaluation so we can get you useful signals quickly.

High-level goals (as discussed):
- Validate Redwood inference latency and integration with your ingestion pipeline
- Measure cost-per-response under realistic volume
- Ensure security controls (VPC + audit logs) meet procurement needs

Suggested 30-day timeline (flexible):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + finalize MAP owners and success criteria
2) Week 1: Integration & baseline tests (sample dataset)
3) Week 2: Performance tuning & batching experiments
4) Week 3: End-to-end validation with champion workflows
5) Week 4: Review & next steps (pricing/procurement)

Proposed owners from our side:
- AE: Ava Chen (me) — program lead, commercial coordination
- CSM: Marissa Cole — onboarding, success criteria and eval monitoring
- SE: Jonas Weber — integration and perf tuning

I'm attaching a one‑page MAP template (MediGroup_MAP_Template.xlsx) — please confirm the champion and any other stakeholders we should include. If it helps, suggest 30 minutes for a quick kickoff to lock owners and timelines.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm champion and any internal stakeholders we should loop in (product/infra/security)
- Pick a time for kickoff (I can send a calendar invite once we agree)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference
